about.title: About MedControl
about.purposeText1: MedControl was born with a clear mission: to help caregivers and families manage their loved ones' medications in a simple, organized, and reliable way.
about.purposeText2: We know how important it is not to miss a dose, and that's why we created this tool to make care easier and safer.
about.developerText1: This application is an independent project, developed with dedication and commitment to offer a useful and accessible tool for everyone.
about.developerText2: 💙 Created with love for those who care for others.
about.freeAppText1: MedControl is and will always be free. No intrusive ads, no locked features, no hidden subscriptions.
about.freeAppText2: If you wish to support the continued development of this app, you can do so voluntarily from the "Support the Project" section.
about.disclaimer1: ⚠️ This application is an organization and reminder tool. It does NOT replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
about.disclaimer2: Always consult a healthcare professional before making medication decisions. Information provided by the AI assistant is for guidance only.
about.privacyText: Your data is yours. Your patients' and medications' information is stored securely and is never shared with third parties.

donate.title: Support the Project
donate.thanks: Thank you for considering supporting us!
donate.subtitle: Your voluntary support helps keep MedControl free and constantly improving.
donate.freeAccess: Let more people access it for free
donate.gratitude1: 💙 Every contribution, regardless of amount, means a lot and motivates us to keep improving.
donate.gratitude2: If you can't donate, don't worry. You can also help a lot by sharing the app with those who need it or leaving a positive review.
